test_title: PYST 54: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

__Success__ is not a destination, it's a journey.
solution:
The correct answer is '**failure**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**success**" means the accomplishment of an aim or purpose. (सफलता)
 
• The antonym of "success" is "**failure**" which means lack of success. (असफलता)

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sensation (संवेदना)**: means a physical feeling or perception resulting from something that happens to or comes into contact with the body.
 
• **Opulence (धनाढ्यता)**: means great wealth or luxuriousness.
 
• **Victory (विजय)**: means an act of defeating an enemy or opponent in a battle, game, or other competition.
